jobs.title: Technical Project Lead & Process Design
jobs.description:
Technical Supplier Manager: Process Design / Industrialization / DFX / Process Design/ Stewardship / Project Governance Operations Support / statistical process control (SPC)/ capability studies (Cpk) / measurement systems analysis / English / Deutsch
Background:
At Roche Diagnostics, we develop and deliver life-critical diagnostic solutions that empower healthcare professionals and patients around the globe. Within the Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) organization, an essential pillar of our Global Instrument Network (GIN), we are seeking an experienced, driven Technical Supplier Manager (m/f/d).
In this role, you will be the vital technical bridge connecting our internal engineering and operations teams with our global network of contract manufacturing partners. You will take technical ownership of instrument components, subassemblies, and production lines. A primary pillar of your daily work is robust manufacturing process design, architecting, validating, and industrializing stable production processes both internally and across supplier sites. Alongside this focus, you will serve as the Technical Project Lead for Technical Transfers (External to External), leading international technology migrations, second-sourcing ramp-ups, and capacity expansions to ensure long-term supply security and premium product quality.

The Perfect Candidate possesses a relevant technical degree and demonstrated expertise in statistical process control and project leadership, specifically in external technology transfers and line ramp-ups. Additionally, strong knowledge of precision manufacturing technologies and production cost optimization is required.
Tasks & Responsibilities:
Manufacturing Process Design & Industrialization (Core Activity)
• Process Architecture & Development: Actively design, optimize, and industrialize robust manufacturing and testing processes for instrument components, electronics, and precision assemblies across the external supply base
• Process Capability & Validation: Define process validation strategies (IQ/OQ/PQ), design verification protocols, and establish process capability baselines (Cp/Cpk analysis, tolerance studies, and Gage R&R)
• Design for Excellence (DfX): Partner closely with R&D during early product development to embed Design for Manufacturing, Assembly, and Testability principles into component designs, preventing manufacturing bottlenecks and driving yield optimization
• Process Risk & Mitigation: Lead process failure mode and effects analysis (pFMEA), establish poka-yoke (error-proofing) controls, and drive root-cause investigations to engineer out process vulnerabilities
Technical Project Leadership & External-to-External (E2E) Transfers
• Lead Technology Transfers: Steer end-to-end technical transfers between external contract manufacturers and suppliers (External-to-External), including production line relocations, tool duplications, and second-source qualifications
• Project Governance & Milestones: Establish qualification master plans (QMPs), define project schedules, align critical milestones, and report progress transparently to cross-functional leadership within MSAT and GIN
• Cross-Partner Synchronization: Lead technical alignment and change control across originating sites, receiving supplier facilities, Roche Global Sourcing, Quality Assurance, and Regulatory Affairs
Technical Supplier Stewardship & Operations Support
• Supplier Performance & Monitoring: Monitor supplier process stability, technical KPIs, and component quality trends across the complete instrument lifecycle
• Deviation Handling & SCARs: Lead technical problem-solving teams (8D, Ishikawa, 5-Why) for component deviations; resolve Supplier Corrective Action Requests sustainably
• Supplier Technical Assessments: Conduct technical evaluations and audits of potential and existing suppliers as part of the formal supplier qualification process
• Operations Projects: Steer supplier-side engineering changes (without spec change), capacity expansions, and continuous line stabilization initiatives

Must Haves:
• A University degree (Bachelor's, Master's, or Higher Technical Diploma) in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field
• At least 5-6+ years of relevant industry experience in manufacturing process design, technical supplier management, industrialization, or manufacturing engineering, ideally within medical devices, in-vitro diagnostics (IVD), pharmaceuticals, or precision high-tech equipment
• Process Design Expertise: Proven hands-on track record in designing, qualifying, and optimizing manufacturing and test processes. Strong command of statistical process control (SPC), capability studies (Cpk), measurement systems analysis (MSA), and pFMEA
• Technical Project Leadership: Demonstrated leadership in complex technical projects, specifically external-to-external technology transfers, second-sourcing initiatives, or major line ramp-ups. Formal PM certification (PMP, IPMA, Agile) is an asset
• Manufacturing Technologies: Deep technical understanding of precision manufacturing technologies (e.g., injection molding, precision mechanics/machining, electronics assembly, automated testing) along with an understanding of production cost drivers and cycle time optimization
• Regulatory & Quality Standards: Practical knowledge of ISO 13485, GMP/FDA regulations, process validation frameworks (IQ/OQ/PQ), and formal change management procedures
• Mindset & Communication: Pragmatic, innovative problem solver with a "think-out-of-the-box" attitude and strong intercultural stakeholder management and communication skills
• Languages & Mobility: Professional fluency in English and German (written and spoken). Willingness to travel globally (approx. 20-30%) for supplier on-site process reviews, audits, and transfer milestones

A conductor stands in front of the orchestra and sets the tone with the baton. A bandleader stands right in the middle, plays along, counts in – and listens carefully to know when it’s time for others’ solos.
That’s exactly the person we are looking for: someone to lead our family-oriented marketing and fundraising agency into the next generation. With groove, with conviction, and with joy in the shared sound.
The Band
asm Fundraising AG has been playing for non-profit organisations, foundations, and public institutions for more than 40 years – on stages throughout Switzerland and in several languages. Our 20 musicians master a wide range of instruments: strategy, creation, data, and fundraising.
What holds us together is not a sheet of music, but a shared attitude. Reliability, respect, and the commitment to serve the cause are the fundamental tone on which everything is built. When planning the tour, the board of directors is on board: as sparring partners who listen, think along, and help shape the shared sound.
Your Role in the Band
• Keep the groove: You set the strategic direction, think ahead, and develop the agency’s repertoire together with the board of directors.
• Play along instead of conducting: You stand in the middle of the team, lead appreciatively and with strong implementation skills, and embody our values – out of conviction, not obligation.
• Enable solos: You recognise talents, nurture and coach them, delegate gladly, and blend individual voices into new sounds.
• Compile the setlist: You manage the client portfolio according to profitability and complexity, win new mandates, and recognise which pieces fit together.
• Keep in time: You have a firm grasp of numbers, key figures, and controlling, use contract models flexibly, and ensure structures that work even without you.
• Dare new pieces: You question the status quo, drive digitalisation forward, and create space for improvisation – without losing sight of the final chord.
• Stand on stage: You represent the agency credibly externally and remain calm when a string breaks.
What You Bring
Your Instrument Case
• Tertiary-level degree (FH or university), ideally with CAS or MBA
• Experience as a managing director or member of executive management
• Fundraising understanding and a network in the NPO and philanthropy sector
• Solid business management skills, negotiation skills, and project management experience
• Digital judgement that does not lose sight of people – with a fine ear for critical questions and feedback
• Understanding of the interplay within federalist Switzerland
• Fluent in German and French, very good in English; Italian is your bonus
Your Sense of Rhythm
• You feel at home in a family business and enjoy playing in an ensemble.
• You are honest, loyal, and reliable – the music is more important than your own applause.
• You listen before you play: with high emotional intelligence and sensitivity to constellations.
• You find the right tone for every audience – from the Federal Councillor to the cleaning staff.
• You make complex things sound simple and create clarity when it gets loud.
• You are curious, courageous, and seek advice when a part is new.
What We Offer You
• Your place on stage: the centre of a well-rehearsed, interdisciplinary band
• A repertoire with meaning: mandates for organisations that advance society and the environment
• Freedom for new arrangements: plenty of creative freedom and a careful handover – we play the first pieces together
• A rehearsal room with the best acoustics: central location in Zurich and modern office infrastructure
• Breaks between concerts: 5 or 6 weeks’ holiday so you return to the stage with fresh energy
• A sound that resonates – even after the last tour: attractive personal insurance, especially strong occupational pension plans, with contributions mostly covered by us
Fancy a jam session?
Then count in: Send us your complete application documents. We are also happy to offer an initial preliminary discussion. Discretion is, of course, guaranteed.

jobs.description:
ProSearch AG is a recruiting agency in Basel specialising in executive search and the filling of key positions. We find executives, specialists, as well as board and foundation members for suitable tasks, teams and corporate cultures.

CFO (Member of the Executive Board) – 100 %
Responsible for finance. Further developing the UZB.
The University Centre for Dental Medicine Basel (UZB) combines patient care, academic teaching and research under one roof. With around 300 employees, approximately 100,000 treatments per year and a turnover of about CHF 40 million, the UZB provides its services, among other things, on the basis of service agreements with the University of Basel and the Canton of Basel-Stadt. We are looking for a CFO with convincing business and financial expertise. As a member of the executive board, entrepreneurial thinking and action are required in addition to financial knowledge in order to manage and further develop the company as a whole.
Your responsibilities
• You are responsible for the financial management of the UZB – from budgeting, liquidity and financial planning to accounting and financial reporting according to Swiss GAAP FER, as well as controlling – and ensure meaningful, tiered reporting to our service providers, the executive board and the board of directors.
• You secure financing and liquidity, further develop risk management and the internal control system, and act as the contact person for the audit committee of the board of directors and the auditors.
• You lead and develop the finance (around 10 employees), IT (3), technical services (3) and purchasing departments with four directly reporting managers and promote collaboration across professional boundaries.
• You advance the digitalisation and further development of processes and systems and play a key role in the ongoing evaluation of a new ERP solution.
• As a member of the executive board, you also bear overall corporate responsibility and actively contribute to corporate development issues.
• You advise the CEO and the executive board as a sparring partner on all business management matters and develop business cases for new offers and projects.
• You create decision-making bases for dialogue with internal and external stakeholders in a public-law environment and maintain contact with relevant stakeholders.
Your professional background
• You have substantial know-how in finance and controlling as well as experience in a responsible financial management role.
• You have completed a (technical) university degree in business administration or are an expert in accounting and controlling; experience with Swiss GAAP FER and SAP is an advantage.
• You have leadership experience, are accustomed to participating in decision-making processes and subsequently implementing decisions consistently within your area of responsibility. You communicate in a nuanced and transparent manner, work pragmatically and combine financial diligence with openness to new solutions.
• You have fluent German and good English skills.
• You are interested in digitalisation and responsible handling of data and new technologies.
• Experience in healthcare or a public-law organisation is welcome but not a prerequisite.
What distinguishes the role
The UZB is a dynamic institution: founded in 2016 and grown by around 30 % since 2021. Our structures, processes and systems can be actively shaped. You combine a key financial role with the opportunity to help shape the further development of an organisation with a social mission from an executive board perspective. The position requires closeness to day-to-day business as well as a reliable overview of the whole.

Swiss craftsmanship for the kitchen –
our passion knows no bounds.
For over 75 years, at Suter Inox AG, we have combined Swiss craftsmanship with innovative technology and a strong service orientation – for discerning customers who value uncompromising quality, predictability, and design freedom.
We are an owner-managed Swiss SME with around 150 employees and our own production facility based in Schinznach-Bad. Our core market is Switzerland, with showrooms in Zurich and Crissier.
